_description: Case state file — single source of truth. Auto-updated by Claude when working on the case.
_rules: Read case.json at session start when entering case folder
Update case.json after any material change (drafts created, deadlines changed, filing completed, etc.)
Update last_updated and last_activity on every change
Recalculate days_remaining in deadlines on each update
Keep progress.completed and progress.pending in sync with reality
